I've escalated it to the ops team (normal priority) to chase or reassign the contractor. I've also flagged three things: the contractor was given two different tenant phone numbers, the tenant said the garden is communal, and the approval on file has no cost cap. The tenant has been emailed an update and a 3-day follow-up hold is set.

judgement.why_this_decision: The contractor was instructed in event 008 and reminded in events 009, 010 and 011, and never replied. The system flag in event 012 asks someone to check. A fifth automated reminder is unlikely to work. Someone needs to phone the contractor or reassign the job, and that is agency judgement. The tenant's answer 'communal area' in event 002 raises a question about who is responsible for the garden, which also needs agency judgement. The tenant had not been updated since 17 Dec.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Three reminders have already gone unanswered, so one more would only add noise.

alternatives_considered.option: Reassign to a different contractor myself
alternatives_considered.why_not: There's no other contractor on record. The gardener may be back from leave soon (event 004). Communal responsibility may mean the job belongs to someone else, so a person should decide.
Nothing has happened for 8 days and the system has flagged it. Waiting longer would leave the job sitting silent.
